description: Example task to exercise the contracts: a short hand-washing routine. Not the chosen demo scenario.

steps.instruction_es: Ahora aplica jabón en la palma.
Frota el dorso de cada mano.
steps.completion_cue: foam on the backs of both hands
no foam left on the hands

steps.instruction_es: Sécate con una toalla de papel.
Cierra la llave usando la toalla.
steps.completion_cue: faucet off, closed through the towel

mistakes.visual_cue: soap applied while the hands are still dry
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, primero hay que mojarse las manos.

mistakes.description: Rubs palms for only a moment.
mistakes.visual_cue: palms touch briefly, almost no foam
mistakes.correction_es: Frota un poco más, al menos unos segundos.

mistakes.description: Closes the faucet with a clean bare hand.
mistakes.visual_cue: a clean bare hand turns the faucet off
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, no toques la llave con la mano limpia: ciérrala con la toalla.
